blocks.data: label:When the level starts: turn gravity off, then do these every tick
label:Read the keys and feel nearby walls
label:Walk or run, then update the run meter
label:Read the arrow keys, x and space
label:Fill the run meter while running
label:Jump: late, early and off a wall
label:Lose run meter when I hit a wall
label:When I run into something on my right
label:When I run into something on my left
label:When a Spring says boing: fly up
label:When I stomp a Walker: bounce
label:When I get hurt: go back to the start
label:When a Bounce block says bounce: launch again, higher if I hold jump
